replies.reasoning:
The user asks "我上雪期有没有却勤" — likely "我上学期有没有缺勤" (Did I have absences last semester?). Last semester relative to current: 2026-2027 学年第1学期 → last semester is 2025-2026 学年第2学期 (spring). So year "2025", term "2".

Need make_plan first, then get_attendance.
